body.h: This is an anticlockwise two count runaround pattern where each person makes two passes as the feeder. It's based on the pulsar.
Starting pattern for Anne: self self Ben self.
Starting pattern for Ben: Clare self Anne self.
Starting pattern for Clare: Ben self self self.
Pattern for Anne: Clare self Ben self Clare self.
Pattern for Ben: self self Anne self self self.
Pattern for Clare: Anne self self self Anne self.
Pattern for Anne: self self Clare self self self.
Pattern for Ben: Clare self self self Clare self.
Pattern for Clare: Ben self Anne self Ben self:
Then the pattern repeats from the start.
